description: Async undo / redo history for a single Notion editor instance. Not a DI service — TmNotionPage creates one instance per page and cascades it to child components via CascadingValue so each page has its own isolated stack. Because provider calls are async the stack exposes async Push / Undo / Redo. The OnStackChanged event is raised on every mutation so the UI can refresh without coupling to the stack's internal implementation.

members.name: BatchScope
members.description: Returns an IAsyncDisposable that begins a batch now and commits it on disposal (or rolls it back if an exception is thrown).

members.name: BeginBatch
members.description: Begins a new batch scope. All commands pushed while the batch is open will be grouped into a single undo / redo step. Nested batches are not allowed.

members.name: ClearAsync
members.description: Clears both stacks (e.g. after navigating to a different page).

members.name: CommitBatch
members.description: Commits the open batch as a single undo step. If the batch contains no commands it is discarded silently.

members.name: PushAsync
members.description: Executes command and pushes it onto the undo stack. When a batch is open the command is appended to it instead of being pushed directly — it will be committed as part of CommitBatchAsync.

members.name: RedoAsync
members.description: Re-applies the most recently undone command. No-op when CanRedo is false.

members.name: RollbackBatchAsync
members.description: Rolls back the open batch: undoes all commands already executed within it and discards the batch without recording it.

members.name: UndoAsync
members.description: Undoes the most recent command. No-op when CanUndo is false.
